// REQ: LANG-481 LANG-482 LANG-483 LANG-484
syntax = "proto3";

package demo.v1;

import "google/protobuf/timestamp.proto";

/* A person. */
message Person {
  string name = 1;
  int32 id = 2;
  repeated string emails = 3;
  map<string, int64> scores = 4;
  google.protobuf.Timestamp created = 5;
  oneof contact {
    string phone = 6;
    bytes photo = 7 [deprecated = true];
  }
  reserved 8, 10 to max;
}

enum Status {
  STATUS_UNSPECIFIED = 0;
  ACTIVE = 1;
}

service People {
  rpc Get (Person) returns (stream Person);
}
